title: TEC WGs Weekly Update: July 04 - July 10

posts.cooked:
Monday, July 11th, 2022

Good Monday everyone! Here are the Working Group Weekly Updates. This past week a lot of our members have been attending ETH Barcelona, so this has been a slow week.

You can see what’s going on on the calendar. You may join us in real time during any of the syncs or check out our YouTube channel archive for hundreds of recorded calls.

Stewards

Stewards: Tamara, Nate
Weekly Sync: Tuesday, 1PM EST/7PM CET

  • We are done with sprint #38. Here is the sprint board so you can see what is going on.
  • From the sprint retrospective we decided that the next task we are going to tackle is a collective roadmap for the TEC.
  • Remember that you can easily help the TEC by retweeting

Gravity

Steward: Juan
Weekly Sync: Wednesday, 11AM EST/5PM CET

  • The Third Graviton Training is ongoing. You can check the study plan here
    • Sessions are on Tuesdays at 8PM CET
    • Next session, number #8, will be facilitated by Jeremy, we will be having a practice session about Liberating Structures.
  • Join us on Mondays for observational research on psychology and wellbeing. We are currently working on a survey to measure wellbeing and mental health.
  • On Tuesdays we have the Umbrella coordination call in Aragon at 11 AM CET
  • On Fridays we have our website desing call at 8PM CET.
  • If you’re in need of help managing a conflict, you can make a request through our typeform

Steward: Livia
Weekly Sync: Wednesday, 1PM EST/7PM CET

  • Check our SWOT Analysis of the TEC. If you have any input, you’re welcome to add it to the file

  • We are also working, together with soft gov, on improving the TE flower. We will soon make a figma file available for people to give us their input.

Rewards

Steward: Mitch
Weekly Sync: Wednesday, 2PM EST/8PM CET

  • Rewards for February 2022 are incoming. Check the forum post and the RAD analysis.
  • #ActivateYourSourceCred - !sc save-wallet 0x000…000. Use the same address you used for activating praise!
  • We have some updates in development:
    • Replacing drafted quantifiers

  • We encourage you to become a quantifier: it is a civic duty within our Commons.
  • Remember that anyone can become a praise-giver by typing the command /activate on any channel within our Discord server.

Thank you for reading the WG Weekly update from July 04 - July 10. Check our calendar and join us on a call soon! Have a great week!
